import pygame

from config import *
from renderer3d import GLContext, OrbitCamera, PlateRenderer3D

# Create a simple earth plate surface for testing
earth_surf = pygame.Surface\(\(700, 700\), pygame.SRCALPHA\)
earth_surf.fill\(\(50, 15, 15\)\)
pygame.draw.rect\(earth_surf, \(140, 110, 60\), \(0, 0, 700, 700\), 4\)

camera_pos = camera.get_eye_position\(\)
